question: Should Control UI add a dedicated expanded composer modal for long prompts, or should the inline autogrow composer plus configurable send shortcut remain the intended long-prompt path?
rationale: The request is coherent and aligned with web-frontend ergonomics, but it adds a second composer mode with draft, attachment, focus, and send semantics that require product/UX ownership rather than bug-fix automation.

options.title: Sponsor Expanded Composer
options.body: Build a bounded Control UI modal editor with separate draft state, Apply, Cancel/Close, Send, focus restoration, and inline-versus-modal keyboard tests.

options.title: Prefer Inline Composer
options.body: Treat the current autogrow textarea plus modifier-send setting as the intended long-prompt solution and close or narrow the modal request by maintainer decision.

options.title: Defer UX Mode Choice
options.body: Keep the issue open but out of repair automation until a Control UI owner chooses the editor shape.

recommendation.title: Sponsor Expanded Composer
recommendation.body: Build a bounded Control UI modal editor with separate draft state, Apply, Cancel/Close, Send, focus restoration, and inline-versus-modal keyboard tests.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest adjacent shortcut ownership, current composer-history signal, and prior review context for this issue.
